test_cases.summary:
Verify Edit mode pre-fills values
when an existing label is selected for edit
test_cases.description:
Feature: Session Label Popup Close, Cancel & Edit Handling
Scenario: Edit mode pre-fills values
Given an existing label is selected for edit
When the popup opens
Then Name, Description and Color should show existing values
test_cases.acceptance:
Name, Description and Color should show existing values
The behavior should be validated when the popup opens.

test_cases.summary:
Verify Update saves edited values
when fields are modified in Edit mode
test_cases.description:
Feature: Session Label Popup Close, Cancel & Edit Handling
Scenario: Update saves edited values
Given fields are modified in Edit mode
When the user clicks Update/Submit
Then the same label record should be updated successfully
test_cases.acceptance:
The same label record should be updated successfully
The behavior should be validated when the user clicks Update/Submit.

test_cases.summary:

When Cancel is clicked

test_cases.acceptance:
The original values should remain unchanged
The behavior should be validated when Cancel is clicked.
